_comment: STRICT Cursor permissions for Auto-review and Allowlist modes. Read-only terminal auto-run only. Empty MCP allowlist. Auto-review block instructions force approval for high-risk families.

allow_instructions: Read-only inspection commands such as ls, cat, head, tail, grep, find, wc, pwd, git status, git diff, and git log may run without asking.
block_instructions: Every command that installs packages or downloads remote code should go through approval first.
Every curl, wget, or piped shell download should go through approval first.
Every sudo, su, or privilege-escalation command should go through approval first.
Every command that reads or prints .env, secret, credential, token, PEM, or key files should go through approval first.
Every AWS, Azure, GCP, or Kubernetes mutating command should go through approval first.
Every docker push, terraform apply, or database DROP or DELETE should go through approval first.
Every git push, git reset --hard, or force-push should go through approval first.
Every MCP tool call should go through approval first.
Every Browser tool call should go through approval first.
